assertions.name: symbolic_derivative_matches_pi2_over_240_d4
assertions.source: Class axiom energyPerArea(d) = -π²/(720 d³) differentiated via sympy.diff; sympy.simplify reduces the residue to 0 exactly.

description: Conditional verification of conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum.  Step 1: sympy-symbolic verification that d/dd[-π²/(720 d³)] = π²/(240 d⁴), discharging the calculus step of the §3b-cond conditional theorem.  Step 2: numerical evaluation of the standard-physics Casimir force per area at four sample plate separations (0.1–5 µm), matching Mohideen–Roy 1998 / Lamoreaux 1997 experimental geometries.  Step 3: explicit enumeration of the three open sub-problems that the conjecture's actual content requires (existence + scaling + prefactor of N_⊙(A, d) as a categorical object).  The conditional implication is rigorous modulo the PlateModeCount class hypothesis; the witness exists to document the rigorous chain and tabulate the numerical targets that any closure must reproduce.

open_subproblems_for_closure.name: prefactor_pi_squared_over_720
open_subproblems_for_closure.description: Derivation of the π²/720 prefactor from a Hecke-trace identity on plate-boundary representations of H_n(q).  Standard physics gets π²/720 from ζ-regularising the cubic mode sum ∑ n³ → ζ(-3) = -B_4/4 = 1/120.  The QOU analogue would be a Markov-trace identity matching this regularisation.
